**Faster lighting.** The slowest views in DOOM and DOOM II used to drop well
below 60 fps in rooms full of light panels and torches; on an M3 Pro at
2560×1600 the worst view in DOOM (E2M7) went from 44 ms to about 14 ms a frame.
The picture is unchanged:

- Lights only test the walls in the direction of each pixel instead of every
  wall around them.
- Walls and floors hidden behind nearer ones no longer run the lighting.
- See-through walls such as bars and fences only light their frontmost layer.
- On maps without a sky, the light bake at level load finishes sooner.

**New options (F4)**

- **Anti-aliasing (MSAA):** off by default, or 2x, 4x or 8x as far as your GPU
  offers. Before this it was always 4x. It smooths the edges of walls and
  floors; texels and sprites stay crisp.
- **Fewer glowing-texture lights** (Performance): only the 8 nearest lamp strips
  and glowing flats light their surroundings per pixel instead of 24. Cheaper
  in rooms full of light panels.
- **Cheat menu (F5):** fly mode, noclip, god mode, no monsters and a map warp.
  `idfly` also toggles flying, and `[` and `]` step through the maps.
- **Relit weapon:** the sheen painted into the weapon artwork is taken out and
  the lights around you relight it.

**Other changes**

- Detail textures are removed.
- Liquids show a faint sky in their reflections.
- Game WADs in another format, such as DOOM 64, get a clear message instead of
  failing to start.
